{{Upgrade component infobox | description = Double-click to apply to a weapon. | variables = Trigger a flame blast with a 240 radius upon [[Critical hit|critically hitting]] a foe.
{{gray|(Cooldown: 5 Seconds)}} | type = sigil | element = Pain | recharge = 5 | rarity = exotic | level = 60 | value = 216 | salvage = Standard, Research | id = 24548 }} == Acquisition == === Recipe === {{recipe | source = recipe sheet | sheet = Recipe: Sigil of Fire | type = Upgrade Component | disciplines = huntsman, artificer, weaponsmith | rating = 400 | ingredient1 = 10 Pile of Lucent Crystal | ingredient2 = 5 Ruby Orb | ingredient3 = 10 Glob of Ectoplasm | ingredient4 = 2 Symbol of Pain | id = 13001 }} === Extracted from === {{contains upgrade component}} === Other === {{mystic forge sigils text}} == Used in == {{recipe list}} == Notes == * The flame blast cannot [[critical hit|critically hit]]. * The flame blast has a 0.85 [[damage|damage coefficient]] and uses the unequipped (690.5) [[weapon strength]] value in damage calculations. * The effect originates at the target with a [[range]] of 240 and affects up to 5 foes. * The flame blast does not inflict [[burning]] * Each foe hit by the flame blast will add adrenaline to the Warrior’s resource pool. * The prices for weapons that contain this are as follows, though it may be more efficient to buy the sigil directly off the Trading Post instead: {{contains upgrade component|format=table}} {{rune and sigil nav}} [[de:Überlegenes Sigill des Feuers]] [[es:Sello superior de fuego]] [[fr:Cachet de feu supérieur]]
title: Superior Sigil of Fire
